Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Paperwork sync: term extension & capacity uplift for Horizon Analytics

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, we're preparing the renewal package that includes: (a) 24‑month term, (b) a capacity uplift to 250M input tokens/month (Order Form line item), and (c) updated SLAs for production latency and availability.

Attached are the draft order form and the MSA redlines I started for internal alignment:
- Redwood_OrderForm_v2.pdf (attachment: order form with capacity tables)
- Proposed_MSA_Redlines_Sean_v1.docx (attachment: inline comments on MSA)

Ask: can your legal team send a clean set of redlines against the MSA and confirm procurement's PO process (billing cadence and PO contact)? It would help if we had the following by end of week so we can get to execution next week:
- Confirm term (24 months ok?)
- Confirm acceptance of proposed token tiers (250M baseline + 20% burst)
- Any required compliance evidence (SOC2 cert link, encryption requirements)

I'll loop in our legal and CS leads to keep timelines tight. If helpful, I can prepare a short mutual action plan + DocuSign envelope once we have a few points nailed.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0128

Sean —

Appreciate the summary. Priya and I reviewed and our legal team has a few redlines and questions — attaching their markup. Key asks up front:
- Term: we prefer 24 months, please confirm you can commit to pricing/coverage for that period (we're asking for price protection language).
- Data retention / audit logs: need audit log availability for 7 years (regulated reporting).
- SLA credits: we need clearer outage credit language and a cap tied to monthly invoice.
- Compliance: please share SOC2 Type II report or link to your attestation.

Also, our procurement team requires a standard PO flow — is Redwood able to accept a PO with net 45 payment terms for this renewal? Who should the PO email to?

Attaching: Horizon_MSA_Redlines_Alex.docx (our legal comments).

Thanks —
Alex Rivera
Director, Platform Partnerships
Horizon Analytics

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@horizonanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizonanalytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood response to Horizon redlines — retention, SLA, PO process

Alex / Priya —

Thank you for the redlines. I've reviewed Horizon_MSA_Redlines_Alex.docx and attached our annotated response (Redwood_Legal_Response.docx). High‑level positions and suggested compromises below:

1) Term & pricing protection
- Redwood accepts a 24‑month term. We will add a price protection clause: no unit price increases for covered products/services during the committed term, excluding changes driven by third‑party costs with 60‑day notice.

2) Audit log retention / data retention
- Horizon requested 7 years. Redwood's standard enterprise retention is 2 years for non‑regulatory audit logs. We can agree to a 2‑year default retention with a carve‑out that permits longer retention where required by law or regulatory obligations (we will add a written request/approval process and reasonable cost recovery).

3) SLA credits
- Agreed to provide clearer outage credits. Proposed language ties credits to a percentage of the monthly invoice with an absolute cap equal to 100% of the affected month's charges. See section 6.3 in Redwood_Legal_Response.docx for redline.

4) SOC2 / compliance evidence
- Please provide a link to Horizon's required evidence portal; we'll share our SOC2 Type II attestation and penetration testing summary under NDA.

5) PO / billing
- Redwood can accept a PO. Preferred flow: procurement@redwood.com for PO submission; standard net 30 is default but we are willing to accept net 45 for this deal pending finance signoff. Please have procurement include the HubSpot deal id (hubspot:3456721) on the PO to speed processing.

We appreciate the regulatory constraints you flagged. If Horizon's internal compliance requires 5+ year retention as a hard requirement, we can scope it as a paid addendum and include KMS key management options.

I've attached our marked document and called out the sections we consider negotiable. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

[attachment: Redwood_Legal_Response.docx (docx)]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizonanalytics.com>

Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@horizonanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood response to Horizon redlines — retention, SLA, PO process

Mina / Sean —

Thanks for the quick response. A few clarifications from Horizon's side:
- Retention: Horizon is in financial services and 7 years is a hard regulatory baseline for certain records. We are open to a paid addendum for extended retention but would like the MSA to show an explicit 7‑year option that we can elect.
- KMS: we will require a BYOK or dedicated KMS keying option for production datasets. Please outline what you can offer; if there are costs, we need them documented in the order form.
- SLA credits language: the proposed percentage cap is acceptable. We do want credits to be automatic (not require multiple claims) when thresholds are met.

Attaching a short doc with our revised asks: Horizon_Revised_Requests.pdf. We'll have procurement send the PO once final language is confirmed — they target net 45.

Best,
Priya Shah
Senior Counsel, Horizon Analytics
priya.shah@horizonanalytics.com

[attachment: Horizon_Revised_Requests.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Paperwork sync and next steps (finalize for signature)

Team / Alex / Priya —

Quick status & ask:
- Commercial: Horizon confirmed 24 months and capacity uplift (250M tokens). Procurement will use net 45; we've accepted net 45 pending finance signoff.
- Legal: Mina proposed 2‑year default retention + paid addendum for extended retention and a KMS/BYOK option. Horizon pushed back to keep 7 years in the MSA; they indicated this is regulatory.
- SLA: agreed in principle to automatic credits tied to monthly invoice with defined cap; Mina's wording in Redwood_Legal_Response.docx is a near match — finalize to include automatic remediation triggers.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Mina: consolidate final MSA redline including a 7‑year paid addendum path and explicit KMS options by EOD Fri (9 May).
- Marissa: prepare final order form with pricing locked for 24 months and billing schedule; include line for PO number and net 45 handling (ETA Fri EOD).
- Sean: prepare DocuSign envelope once legal provides consolidated redline; target sending for signature Mon morning.

If Mina can confirm the wording on the retention addendum and KMS pricing, I'll coordinate our finance to accept net 45 and request procurement's PO. Alex / Priya — please confirm procurement contact and any internal reference numbers so Marissa can add them to the order form.

Thanks all — this keeps us on track to complete signature next week.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
